--- README ---
Prepare the billing statement for CUS-004 at Beacon.
Source documents: beacon-billing-04.csv and beacon-billing-terms-04.csv.
Invoice amount = quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_rate) * (1 + tax_rate) + shipping. Use the values in the terms table. Round monetary amounts to two decimal places using half-even rounding. Deliver JSON with record_id and amount.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io, json
billing='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,shipping
CUS-001,28,63.66,74
CUS-002,40,55.6,62
CUS-003,72,30.9,24
CUS-004,16,11.51,53
CUS-005,34,64.0,43
CUS-006,55,60.08,66
CUS-007,37,65.85,19
CUS-008,66,36.68,62
CUS-009,40,15.6,44
CUS-010,53,22.76,34
'''
disc=Decimal('0.0837'); tax=Decimal('0.0673')
q=Decimal('0.01')
out=[]
total=Decimal('0')
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(billing)):
    amt=Decimal(r['quantity'])*Decimal(r['unit_price'])*(1-disc)*(1+tax)+Decimal(r['shipping'])
    rnd=amt.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    out.append((r['record_id'],amt,rnd))
    total += rnd
for x in out: print(x)
print('total', total, 'formatted', total.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
PY

from decimal import Decimal as D, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
from io import StringIO
import csv
s='''record_id,regular_hours,overtime_hours,hourly_rate,deduction
EMP-001,159,7,31.19,202
EMP-002,145,6,27.4,165
EMP-003,158,7,42.76,168
EMP-004,130,9,23.1,138
EMP-005,144,4,23.06,173
EMP-006,148,9,40.39,174
EMP-007,154,10,32.54,138
EMP-008,150,2,36.51,231
EMP-009,156,8,45.9,191
EMP-010,143,6,32.84,207
'''
q=D('.01'); rate=D('.2137'); mult=D('1.73')
sums=[D(0),D(0)]
for r in csv.DictReader(StringIO(s)):
  gross=D(r['regular_hours'])*D(r['hourly_rate']) + D(r['overtime_hours'])*D(r['hourly_rate'])*mult
  grossr=gross.quantize(q,ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
  net1=(gross*(1-rate)-D(r['deduction'])).quantize(q,ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
  net2=(grossr*(1-rate)-D(r['deduction'])).quantize(q,ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
  print(r['record_id'],gross,grossr,net1,net2,net1-net2)
  sums[0]+=net1;sums[1]+=net2
print(sums)
PY
